column1: # Fixture base config. Shared by Config_TST.xlsx and Config_PRD.xlsx, so config-parity and
# assets-parity are silent by default. Format: Sheet<TAB>Name<TAB>Value
# Values are chosen so that NO value-driven rule fires: a real queue name, a real
# business-process name, a non-zero circuit breaker, ShouldMarkJobAsFaulted True, and an
# absolute path (a relative one would trip relative-persisted-path).
